BiblicalUsage: The word is steadfastness, and Peter uses it once as a warning: beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness. The firm ground can be lost.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe steadfastness is something to keep, and the error of the wicked is the slope it slides on.
